map.按六个维度评分并结合岗位类型加权，输出综合胜任力与短板维度，生成发展建议草稿；结: Score six dimensions and weight them by job type to output an overall competency score and weak dimensions, producing a draft development plan; results are for self-assessment and initial screening, and formal appointment should follow the organisation assessment process.
map.晋升评审前由主管按六个维度打分，结合岗位权重（管理/技术/销售）得到加权总分与等: Before a promotion review, the manager scores six dimensions and applies job-type weights (managerial / technical / sales) to obtain a weighted total and grade.
map.社招初筛时快速给出胜任力画像，把低于 6 分的维度标为面试追问重点。: During external-hire screening, quickly produce a competency profile and flag dimensions below 6 as interview probing priorities.
map.培训规划期汇总团队评分，看哪个维度整体偏低，据此排下季度课程。: During training planning, aggregate team scores to see which dimension is generally low, then schedule next quarter courses accordingly.
map.同一份评分在不同岗位下的差异: The same scores under different job types
map.六维均为 8/7/9/7/7/8：技术岗权重下综合约 8.05（优秀），管理岗权: With all six dimensions at 8/7/9/7/7/8: the technical weighting gives about 8.05 (excellent) and the managerial weighting about 7.60, showing the employee is better suited to deepening a technical track and would need to build teamwork and drive for execution before moving into management.
map.销售岗评分中「创新思维」仅 4 分被标为待提升，综合 6.9 属合格；发展计划应: In the sales weighting, "innovative thinking" at only 4 is flagged as needing improvement while the overall 6.9 is acceptable; the development plan should address innovative thinking before promotion, since a low dimension undermines the credibility of the overall profile.
map.页面内置管理/技术/销售三套经验权重（如技术岗专业知识 30%、问题解决 25%: The page ships three empirical weight sets (managerial / technical / sales), e.g. technical roles weight professional knowledge 30% and problem solving 25%; organisations can adjust to their own competency model and convert manually.
map.1–10 分怎么打才不失真？: How do I score 1-10 without distortion?
map.先给每个分数档定义行为锚点（如 7 分＝能独立解决常见问题并沉淀方法），再对照打: First define behavioural anchors for each score level (e.g. 7 = can independently solve common problems and codify methods), then score against them; without anchors, scores skew high and lose discrimination.
map.结果能直接用于晋升决策吗？: Can the result be used directly for promotion decisions?
map.只能作为自评与初筛参考。正式任用应结合绩效记录、360 评估与组织流程，单次打分: Only as a reference for self-assessment and initial screening. Formal appointment should combine performance records, 360 reviews and organisational process; a single score is not enough to support a personnel decision.
map.胜任力模型包含知识、技能、能力、个性特质四个层次: A competency model has four layers: knowledge, skills, abilities and personality traits
map.不同岗位维度权重不同：管理岗侧重沟通和协作，技术岗侧重专业和问题解决: Dimension weights differ by role: managerial roles emphasise communication and teamwork, technical roles emphasise expertise and problem solving
map.评分低于6分的维度应制定个人发展计划(IDP): Dimensions scoring below 6 should have an individual development plan (IDP)
map.建议每半年评估一次，跟踪胜任力发展轨迹: Assess every six months to track the competency development trajectory
map.岗位胜任力评估工具，输入六个维度评分，按岗位类型加权计算综合胜任力并生成发展建议: A job competency assessment tool: enter six dimension scores to compute a job-weighted overall competency and generate development suggestions.
